Iv.bar_b_note: The naturalistic ram reads well standing and is taller than the trainer, but the B faint frames collapse into a legless white fleece pillow with outsized detached-looking horns and A's faint end rolls the body awkwardly, so it falls short of the owner bar finish.

Vy.bar_b_note: Only the trainer stands in view while Kelm and Captain Veyra speak from portraits, in front of a flat beige wall with pasted wooden doors, which sinks the staging.

Cz.bar_b_note: Murky brown frames with no purple storm sky, flat magenta ground rings and chevrons as telegraphs, a barely visible player creature, and in B i12-i15 the camera buried in canopy or trunk.

Lx.bar_b_note: Hard-edged white puff meshes hanging off the cliff, a black stretched shadow wedge on the cliff face in frame 3 and a flat milky cloud floor read as placeholder, not Valheim-class atmosphere.

Lw.bar_b_note: A flat uniform grass carpet with isolated blocky crags and almost no trees or ledges reads empty beside Palworld's dense plateau.

Ui.bar_b_note: Both fighters and the bird are now in frame with good creature appeal, but the large pale captain creature is cropped at the frame edge in live-2430 and live-3870 and heavy HUD panels plus a flat sand arena keep it below Palworld finish.

Yk.bar_b_note: Grass blades still poke through the cobbles at heartstone close, and the high perches tower is a smeared low-detail cylinder over flat green ground, so close-range materials do not reach the finish.

Vt.bar_b_note: The domed rotunda now has a solid blue dome and pale walls and stays readable at night, but it is still a small single building on a flat grass path, nowhere near the board's layered cliff sanctuary.

Nk.bar_b_note: Blocky straight-sided shelves and crags, a camera jammed against a blobby rock in heartstone approach and flat grass plains read as greybox terrain.

Eu.bar_b_note: A warm, readable elder villager with clear eyes, earthy greens and browns and a clean full-body silhouette carries it, though the face leans more toon than the naturalistic world.

Fy.bar_b_note: The golden and night grades help, but a flat saturated cyan post is still the loudest object at the three bells bridge and the bridge itself is lost behind a foreground trunk.

Gh.bar_b_note: The upright rider standing on clouds below the terrace in terrace_01 to 03, with a black shadow wedge on the cliff, reads as broken traversal, not a crossing.

Hl.bar_b_note: B's mottled gold-black scales, open fanged head and grounded coils reach the owner bar; A's flat yellow-black bands and faint poses floating in mid-air above a detached shadow would sink it alone.

top_changes.change: Rebuild Cloudreach ground as layered pale stratified stone terraces, ledges and groves instead of flat grass carpets, with softened, non-extruded shelf edges and shaped island undersides (Lw, Nk, Yk, Vt surroundings)
Replace the polygonal white puff clouds and flat cloud floor with soft volumetric cloud banks and keep mounted traversal on supported terrain at terrace edges (Lx, Gh)
Build the summit aviary as a layered cliff-top stone sanctuary with glass dome, towers and bridges per the Sky Aviary board, and stage named speakers in view during dialogue (Vt, Vy)
